# China (Desert)

`ghost_faction_china_ard`

A content pack: 176 unit classes and 10 weapon and item classes. No scripted behaviour.

## Requires

- `ghost_main`
- `ghost_uniform`
- `ghost_vests`
- `ghost_weapons`

Carries `skipWhenMissingDependencies` - the PBO is skipped rather than breaking the load order when something above is absent.
